title: Practice: How long, how long ago, how old

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: He advanced his departure by two days.
exercises.why: After «два»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
After «три»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Через десять ___ (минута) после нокаута боксёр пришёл в сознание.
exercises.prompt: Ten minutes after the knockout, the boxer regained consciousness.
exercises.why: After «десять»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Компьютерная система автоматически отключается в восемь ___ (вечер).

exercises.why: After «восемь»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
